feeds.title: Nomad Raceways Blog
feeds.description: Insights into slot car event professionals' passions and philosophies. Nomad Raceways slot car track rental brings racing excitement to your next event. We are entertainers with table top car race games that your guests control with remotes.

feeds.title: Home Racing World
feeds.description: Home Racing World is your Online Home For Slot Car Racing & Collecting. Here you can get information on categories like HRW Speed Shop, Race Events, Resin Shop, Scratchbuilding, Slot Car, Gallery, Slot Car Garage Tech Tips, and many more!

feeds.title: Weevils Slot Cars
feeds.description: Suppliers of Scalextric, Pioneer, Carrera, Avant Slot, and Teamslot. NSR, Slot it, Fly slot cars, and more! Weevils Slot Cars' new website is the next step in making our dream become reality. We have both been slot car fans since our formative years and want to expand the hobby to a wider audience.

feeds.title: HC Slots
feeds.description: Dan and I both continue to chase ideas and develop new parts. One idea I zeroed in on in late 2015 was the purchase of Life Like HO Racing from Walthers in Milwaukee. My desire and goal are to be able to re-launch the Life Like HO Racing brand with a new image and perhaps some new technology. I have more ideas than I have the resources to execute them.

feeds.title: Austin Slot Car Club
feeds.description: The Austin Slot Car Club is a mix of enthusiasts from all over the world with a passion for auto racing, music, and of course slot cars. We believe in sharing our passion for slot cars by helping others discover how fun and rewarding the hobby can be.

feeds.title: Electric Dreams Blog
feeds.description: The World's Best Slot Car and Slot Car Racing Resource! Electric Dreams was born in 1992 when the demand for vintage slot cars exploded. Now in the hands of businessman, Scott Bader, Electric Dreams has become one of the largest sellers of new and vintage slot car racing products in the 1/24 and 1/32 scales.

feeds.title: Slot Car Club
feeds.description: SlotCarClub.co.uk, is a private Slot Club based near Brands Hatch in Kent. We race digital Scalextric cars but also have classes using Carrera and Slot-it. Attendance to our Club is by invitation only.

feeds.title: London Scalextric Club Blog
feeds.description: London Scalextric Club Blog informs you about slot car racing in London. The London Scalextric Club began life in 1977 when its founder Roy Charlesworth decided the time was right to resurrect his hobby and passion for slot car racing once more.

feeds.title: Bonza Slot Cars Blog
feeds.description: With the Bonza Slot Cars Blog, I aim to supply slot cars, parts, tools, and other hobby-related goods to like-minded people at a great price. I pride myself on honesty and integrity, so you will be in good hands.

feeds.title: Slot Track Pro
feeds.description: Slot Track Pro is your slot car racing resource. Here you can find articles like Scalextric Track Plans 3rd Edition, Slot Track Pro-Track Pack 5, Best Slot Car Tracks, Top 5 Slot Car Track Designer Programs, and more!

feeds.title: Slot Racer Online
feeds.description: Slot Racer Online is a site for slot car racers across the world. It provides information on categories like Carrera, digest, events, history, graphics, forum, media, plans, scenery, slot vars, tracks, and many more!

feeds.title: Digital Slot Car Association
feeds.description: Guidance, Governance, and Best Practice for Digital Slot Car Racing Worldwide. The Digital Slot Car Association exists to promote digital slot car racing and share best practices for governance of competition and car standards.

feeds.title: Slotcars.us
feeds.description: The Place for Everything Slotcar! We have articles on topics like New Slot Car Racing videos, 46th Annual H.O.P.R.A. Nationals- The Bertram Inn- Aurora OH, Viper Scale Racing, Pacific Slot Car Raceway, and many more!

feeds.title: Kelowna Slot Car Club Blog
feeds.description: Kelowna Slot Car Club Blog has posts about Proxy Blog written by kelownaslotcar. The premier slot car event in Canada, bringing together several of Canada's major slot car clubs on Kelowna Slot Car Club.

feeds.title: Viking Scalextric & Slot Car Club Blog
feeds.description: Race-time lap counting and timing are managed with the SlotMaster software and hardware system. The track is constructed using a standard Scalextric Sport track and is placed upon a permanent and purpose-built cut-to-shape support 'table' structure. Electrical power is distributed around the circuit to assist even power levels.

feeds.title: Jadlam Toys And Models » Slot
feeds.description: Get to know about all the slots on Jadlam Toys And Models. Jadlam Racing Models is an awesome Model & Toy Store. We started off specializing in Slot Car products but over time have added various Toy and Model brands.

feeds.title: Auto World Blog
feeds.description: Auto World Store is your one-stop shop for hobby-related items including diecast supplies, scale model kits, and more at a reasonable price! Shop today! We offer you hundreds of diecast vehicles, model kits, slot cars, race sets, and accessories, plus limited edition exclusives that you can't find anywhere else.

feeds.title: Slot Car News
feeds.description: Slot car news, photos from all slot car manufacturers. We have articles like November 2022 News from Betta & Classic, New BMW M6 Production Body from RTR, 2023 AWRA National Championship Races, and many more!
